video_title: Blake, Dirk, Steve & UD speak on Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown "beef"

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum denies any animosity toward Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: I don't have any animosity or beef or ill will towards him
quotes.quote: I don't have any animosity or beef or ill will towards him. The frustrating part is since he's not with the Celtics anymore, the narrative or the conversations haven't been enough about what we accomplished, all the games we won, winning a championship, how we've grown together. It's turned into this drama type of thing. At this point in our lives, we're too old to be having our relationship discussed on the internet.

quotes.speaker: Blake Griffin
quotes.summary_phrase: Blake Griffin expresses disappointment in the narrative surrounding Tatum and Brown
quotes.excerpt: I just feel a little bit disappointed. You can hear the disappointment in his voice
quotes.quote: I just feel a little bit disappointed. You can hear the disappointment in his voice because he's exactly right. The narrative, the conversation should be these two guys were All-NBA, they were in the playoffs every year leading a franchise, winning a championship from 19 on. They were both 19 when they got drafted. Being their teammate, being inside the locker room, I know Jayson Tatum cares about him. I thought he said the right thing. He reached out to him after he got traded, called him, texted him, and everybody processes it in their own time.

quotes.speaker: Udonis Haslem
quotes.summary_phrase: Udonis Haslem urges Tatum and Brown to resolve their issues privately
quotes.excerpt: Don't give the world a satisfaction of watching what's going on between you guys

text_blocks.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
text_blocks.text: With that perspective, what do you want for those two?

text_blocks.speaker: Udonis Haslem
text_blocks.text: I want them to hash it out. I know it takes time and feelings are hurt and there's some frustration there, but you've been a critical part of each other's journey up until this point. Neither one of you guys are going to get to where you're at right now without each other. Just understand that. Don't give the world a satisfaction of watching what's going on between you guys. Handle that as men. It doesn't have to happen right now, maybe you take the season and talk about it throughout the summer. But you guys have accomplished things that not many are going to accomplish. Protect that.

quotes.speaker: Dirk Nowitzki
quotes.summary_phrase: Dirk Nowitzki hopes Tatum and Brown can move past the drama
quotes.excerpt: I don't want to see all this drama between these guys
quotes.quote: I don't want to see all this drama between these guys. They've had an incredible run, they've had an amazing partnership, they won a championship. That's what it's all about. You've been through all the tough times and you come out on top and that really should form a bond that lasts a lifetime. I agree with both you guys, I don't want them to have any bad feelings. Hopefully they can hash it out and move forward. They're both terrific players, terrific people, and they'll figure it out. So please, no more drama, let's focus on hoops.

quotes.speaker: Steve Nash
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Nash on the inevitability of player narratives in modern media
quotes.excerpt: Everyone's got to have a story or a tweet or a post
quotes.quote: It's just the way the world nowadays. Everyone's got to have a story or a tweet or a post or whatever it may be, whether you're the media or you're a player. But I think it just depends on the personality of the player. Everyone's going to respond differently. You can see that obviously these two guys kind of responded differently in this situation so far. It's normal. Guys are going to have their own approach, their own feelings, their own take on the way they want to handle something.

quotes.speaker: Dirk Nowitzki
quotes.summary_phrase: Dirk Nowitzki jokes about Luka Doncic's post-game press conference
quotes.excerpt: I think he doubled down afterwards in the press conference
quotes.quote: I think it's all fun and the competition, he talked trash. I think he doubled down afterwards in the press conference as you guys have seen. A little too much, a little too much for me. Stay in your lane, rook. You got two games on your belt, let's see what you got first.

quotes.speaker: Udonis Haslem
quotes.summary_phrase: Udonis Haslem criticizes Luka Doncic for trash talking
quotes.excerpt: I'm for all of it except for the potty mouth Luka
quotes.quote: I'm for all of it except for the potty mouth Luka. You can't say certain things you can't say on the basketball court, people got to come to your locker room. You got to be careful about what you say out there on that court sometimes. That's all I'm going to say.
